newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Capricorn says more nickel at JV site.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Capricorn says more nickel at JV site.

text.p: Capricorn Resources Australia NL said on Friday it had received encouraging reports of additional nickel intersections from its partner in Western Australia's Roundtop joint venture, Forrestania Gold NL.

Recent drilling has involved step-outs from the recently discovered nickel sulphide mineralisation at the nearby Emily Ann prospect, as well as first pass testing of a separate target 400 metres northwards along strike, Capricorn said.
RTD 24, located 260 metres north of the discovery hole RTD 16, confirmed continuation of mineralisation encountered to date at Emily Ann, Capricorn said.
RTD 23, located 610 metres north of discovery hole RTD 16, intersected a very similar package of rocks and mineralisation as that found at Emily Ann, Capricorn said.
The Emily Ann prospect forms part of the Roundtop joint venture between Capricorn, 25 percent, and Forrestania and South African mining house Gencor Ltd, 37.5 percent each.

"Our immediate strategy will be to infill the gap between RTD 23 and RTD 24 with one drill rig and to step-out on widely spaced sections to the north of RTD 23 with another drill rig to do first pass testing of several other targets," Forrestania Gold's chairman, Kim Robinson said in a statement.
